about: The offertorium of the formulary “3rd Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: They trust in You who cherish Your name, O Lord, for You forsake not those who seek You. Sing praise to the Lord enthroned in Sion, for He has not forgotten the cry of the afflicted.
g: play on the cithara (by plucking with fingers)
